# Bengal Taxi

> Reliable cab service across North Bengal — Siliguri, Darjeeling, Sikkim, Dooars and Bagdogra Airport.

Bengal Taxi is a locally-run taxi service based in Siliguri, West Bengal, India.
Trusted since 1995, we provide safe, comfortable and affordable travel for tourists
and locals across North Bengal, Darjeeling hills, Sikkim and the Dooars forest belt.

## Services

- **Airport Pickup & Drop** — Bagdogra Airport (IXB) transfers to any destination in North Bengal
- **Darjeeling Tour Taxi** — Hill station taxi with experienced mountain drivers
- **Sikkim Tour Taxi** — Complete Sikkim circuit packages including permit assistance
- **Dooars Tour Taxi** — Wildlife safari transfers, resort pickups, jungle routes
- **Mirik Tour** — Lakeside sightseeing and tea garden visits
- **Kurseong Tour** — Heritage drives, Makaibari tea estate, Eagle's Craig viewpoint
- **Local Taxi Siliguri** — Hourly and point-to-point city rides
- **Outstation Taxi** — Long-distance travel across West Bengal and beyond
- **Corporate Taxi** — Monthly billing, executive vehicles, dedicated support

## Fleet

- Swift Dzire (Sedan) — 4 passengers, airport runs and city rides
- Ertiga (MPV) — 6 passengers, family trips
- Innova (SUV) — 6–7 passengers, hill tours
- Innova Crysta (Premium SUV) — 6–7 passengers, premium hill and Sikkim travel
- Tempo Traveller (Minibus) — 12–16 passengers, group tours

## Why Choose Bengal Taxi

- Operating since 1995 — 31+ years of experience
- 50,000+ trips completed
- 24×7 availability — 365 days a year
- Fixed, transparent pricing — no surge or hidden charges
- Verified, hill-trained drivers
- GPS-tracked, insured vehicles
- Deep local knowledge of every hill route
